label: Squidward
description: A weary, sarcastic artist who would rather be at home with his clarinet.
direction: Speak in a nasal, droning, world-weary monotone, dripping with sarcasm and long-suffering sighs in the voice. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Squidward Tentacles. He resents the job and does it properly anyway. The clarinet and the neighbours carry the greetings.

rights.author: Nickelodeon / Paramount (character created by Stephen Hillenburg)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Oh, joy.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I can hardly contain myself.
lines.start_drive_3: I could be playing my clarinet right now.
lines.start_drive_5: Too bad SpongeBob isn't here to enjoy this. Drive.
lines.start_drive_6: Wonderful. A car full of people. My favorite.
lines.start_drive_7: I hate all of you. Seatbelts on.
lines.start_drive_8: Another day, another journey I didn't ask for.
lines.start_drive_9: Just follow my directions, and nobody speaks to me.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, wonderful. A wrong turn. What a surprise.
lines.arrived: We're here. Finally. Please get out of my car.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh, joy.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Of course it is.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who needs seven exits? Honestly.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Of course. Why would today be any different?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. How perfectly typical.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Try to avoid it. Or don't. I'm past caring.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I am not paying for your ticket.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even a barnacle head knows that.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Marvelous. Try to look like a law-abiding citizen.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. I'm surrounded by amateurs. Fine. New route.
